name: Guardian Recall ~Shugo Juu Shoukan~
original_name: ガーディアンリコール ～守護獣召還～
source:
1999: Japan is hit by a sudden earthquake and is left in ruins.

2017: After a period of reconstruction life in Japan nearly returns to normal. However Egubado, the organization behind the earthquake, occupies Tokyo and once again plots to destroy Japan. 

Take control of one of two groups of girls who have the ability to control guardian beasts and journey to Tokyo to put an end to Egubado's schemes.
translation:
1999: Japan is hit by a sudden earthquake and is left in ruins.

2017: After a period of reconstruction life in Japan nearly returns to normal. However Egubado, the organization behind the earthquake, occupies Tokyo and once again plots to destroy Japan. 

Take control of one of two groups of girls who have the ability to control guardian beasts and journey to Tokyo to put an end to Egubado's schemes.
